title: Opal Resolution Spec v1
description: The immutable rubric applied to current authoritative information when resolving an Opal Assertion.
$comment: Opal clients separately enforce a 16,384-byte maximum on the exact UTF-8 JSON because JSON Schema does not express a total encoded-byte limit.

definitions.description: Terms whose meanings must be fixed to apply the statement consistently. May be empty.

sources.description: Authoritative sources ordered from highest to lowest priority.

unavailableBehavior.description: Whether resolution falls through to the next ordered source or becomes Unresolvable. The final source cannot use next-source.

conflictBehavior.description: Current information from the highest-ranked available source controls when sources conflict.

ambiguityHandling.description: Normative instructions for statement-specific ambiguity that do not override source ordering or protocol evidence timing.

rationale.description: Optional human-readable context. Non-normative and cannot override any other field.
